description: This file defines the 'ShippingMethod' class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling the retrieval of available shipping methods based on the shipping address. It interacts with extensions and models to gather shipping options and sort them accordingly.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: A model class extending the base Model class, responsible for fetching and processing available shipping methods based on the provided shipping address.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts available shipping methods for a given shipping address by interacting with extensions and shipping models.
